commonClauses.implementation: List only when capability declared; preserve names, untrusted descriptions/annotations and input/output schema declarations. No tools/call or x-mcp-header execution validation.
Bound syntax inspection only for 2020-12; unsupported dialect/oversized/unresolved external references remain unknown. No instance validation or remote reference resolution.
Bounded opaque cursors; retain observed partial declarations but no complete count on unknown or capped pages.
Record only HTTP challenge hints. Do not follow metadata, discover/register clients, authenticate or inspect environment credentials.

Record advertised ui extension settings and tool ui.resourceUri/visibility; optional resource-list URI/MIME declarations. No Apps negotiation, resource read, HTML rendering, CSP/security assertion or app/tool execution.

futureListingJoin.note: A repository/source reference is not an MCP endpoint. Preserve all 616 routes and both Neon slugs. Live receipt attribution requires a new reviewed contract revision and explicit source-to-endpoint-to-listing relationship, never a name-only join.
futureListingJoin.state: design_only; no synthetic fixture may be assigned to a catalog listing

clauses.implementation: request() includes version, empty relevant capabilities and client identity on every request.
Mirror version and method in headers; accept JSON and SSE; POST only.
Pinned DiscoverResult declaration shape, requested version must be in supportedVersions, server identity remains self-reported.
Require current ttlMs/cacheScope in this profile; capture hints without storing/reusing any runtime cache.
No initialize, GET stream, session, DELETE or resumable stream. An unexpected session is an observer incompatibility, not a quality verdict.

profiles.fallback: disabled; record unknown and require an explicitly separate profile run

clauses.implementation: Initialize, require exact supported version, send initialized notification before lists.
Carry optional returned session only in the local fixture process, never persist value.
Send negotiated version on every subsequent request; no modern metadata assumptions.

profiles.fallback: disabled; negotiated versions other than this exact profile remain unknown
profiles.session: optional, transient fixture memory only; no receipt value

purpose: Capture self-declared discovery evidence; never conformance, runtime or security certification.
unsupported: Arbitrary URL or live endpoint probing
Schema instance validation or tool transport-header semantic conformance
